bird.name: Numfor leaf warbler
bird.blurb:
The Numfor leaf warbler is a species of Old World warbler in the family Phylloscopidae.
It is endemic to Numfor in Indonesia.

wiki.title: 1986 New York Mets season
wiki.extract: During the 1986 Major League Baseball (MLB) season, the New York Mets won the National League East, the National League Championship Series (NLCS) and the 1986 World Series, the team's second and most recent World Series championship. General manager Frank Cashen and manager Davey Johnson built a powerful team that compiled one of the best regular season records in MLB history.
